description: This file contains utility extension methods for scheduling tasks and work items within the Orleans Runtime Scheduler component. It provides methods to queue actions and work items with inline execution suppression.

classes.name: TaskSchedulerUtils
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for scheduling tasks and work items in the Orleans Runtime Scheduler.

methods.name: QueueAction (ActivationTaskScheduler, Action)
methods.description: Queues an action to be executed by the specified ActivationTaskScheduler.

methods.name: QueueAction (ActivationTaskScheduler, Action<object>, object)
methods.description: Queues an action with a state object to be executed by the ActivationTaskScheduler.

methods.name: QueueWorkItem (WorkItemGroup, IWorkItem)
methods.description: Enqueues a work item to the specified WorkItemGroup scheduler.

methods.name: QueueWorkItem (IWorkItemScheduler, IWorkItem)
methods.description: Enqueues a work item to the specified IWorkItemScheduler.
